_comment: RAGGit desktop client configuration (feature 031-remote-workstation-hosting). Copy this file over the deployed client's appsettings.json, next to RAGGit.Client.WPF.exe, then replace the two placeholder values. BOTH are required: a Workstation:Url without a Workstation:ApiKey resolves to the invalid-config client. Use the workstation's LAN address in local mode, or its private/VPN address in private cloud mode. Editing this file needs no rebuild or reinstall.
